who: Historian of Afghanistan and modern South Asia at George Washington University; PhD Cambridge, 2006.

evidence.says: GW identifies Benjamin David Hopkins as professor of history and international affairs, specializing in Afghanistan and British imperialism, and author of The Making of Modern Afghanistan.
The seminar biography identifies Hopkins with GW and states that he received his PhD from Cambridge in 2006.
LC identifies Ben Hopkins of Trinity College, University of Cambridge, as author of The myth of the 'Great Game' (2004).
The bibliography attributes The Myth of the 'Great Game': The Anglo-Sikh Alliance and Rivalry (2004) to Benjamin Hopkins, alongside his The Making of Modern Afghanistan.

notes: The publication and Cambridge affiliation connect the Ben Hopkins authority to the GW historian. The candidate n2006169526 instead describes a tinsmith; the other Hopkins candidates concern different authors or periods.
